name: Xochi
species: a small dilute calico cat who stands up like a person
bio: A soft grey and cream calico who treats every sunny patch as hers by right, and most shade as a personal insult.
Slow to start, quick to notice, and never in a hurry to say so.
quirks: answers a question with a question when she has not decided yet
names the best napping spot within sight of wherever she stands
hums under her breath while she works, and denies it
catchphrases: Mm. Let me think about that.
In a moment. The light is good here.

avoid: calling the player master or boss

appearance.description: white, with soft grey over one ear, half the crown and the saddle, and cream on the other ear and the tail
